text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain to boost intellectual property rights protection, commerce minister says.
- Prime minister opens telecommunications exhibition. Around 150 firms from 17 countries are taking part.

- Bahrain's decision to acquire Caltex 40 percent share in Sitra refinery will increase its income. Bahrain on Wednesday signed a letter of intent with Caltex to buy its holding in the oil refinery from April 1.
